environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has two listener rules evaluated in priority order before the default forward-to-target action. Priority 1: AWS WAFv2 WebACL association with rule group reference statement using 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' (with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override to COUNT) and a second rule with a RegexPatternSet match condition on query string values matching pattern `(?i)(?:union|select|insert|update|delete|drop|;|--|/\*|\*/|char\(|concat\(|0x[0-9a-f])` with action BLOCK, evaluated at priority 0 (highest). Additionally, the ALB access logs are shipped to CloudWatch with a metric filter alarm, but this is monitoring-only.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL attached
config.text_transformations_applied: URL_DECODE -> LOWERCASE -> COMPRESS_WHITE_SPACE before regex evaluation
config.compute: ECS Fargate, task role with no additional permissions
config.monitoring: ALB access logs to CloudWatch, metric filter on 4xx/5xx (alerting only, no blocking)
